institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Time-consuming preparation of traditional Indian dishes and the need to retain fresh flavors in instant foods.
description: A technology to produce ready-to-constitute dehydrated coconut gravy mixed with spices such as chili, turmeric, mango, cumin, and jeera. The process uses a developed drying technology, RADD, and size reduction devices to create instant culinary bases.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-cook traditional gravy mixes • Production of shelf-stable commercial culinary pastes and bases • Processing of dehydrated coconut and spice culinary products • Formulation of quick-prep institutional catering ingredients
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
